title: Governed record-linkage project tour
description: Run a typed linkage workflow that pauses for human review, then prepares clusters, audit tables, and acknowledged person output without merging records.
prerequisite: Import the Synthetic Patient Record Linkage example project. It includes two source tables, five known truth links, and a saved command tour.

steps.title: Confirm the governed boundary
steps.instruction: The project contains two fictional eight-record sources and a five-link truth table. No comparison, threshold classification, or merge runs automatically when the project opens.

steps.title: Open the saved linkage workflow
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm. The complete workflow is stored with the project.

steps.title: Load visible linkage source
steps.instruction: Choose recordlink-command-tour and select Open. Loading the program does not execute it.

steps.title: Verify the workflow
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program. Review the QUALITY, LIST, FREQ, TABLES, and governed EPIAI RECORDLINK commands before execution.

steps.title: Run reviewed comparisons
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands. The workflow blocks candidates, calculates deterministic scores, and pauses at EPIAI RECORDLINK REVIEW. Nothing mutates either source.

steps.title: Review candidate scores and classes
steps.instruction: Inspect blocking counts, score distribution, threshold classes, truth-set precision/recall/F1, and field-level contributions. Candidate identifiers and patient values remain out of Output and history.

steps.title: Record an explicit decision
steps.instruction: Compare the one-day date variation, choose Match and a controlled reason, then select Save decision. The program resumes through CLUSTER, AUDIT, and OUTPUT only after the review is conclusive.

steps.title: Export governed review evidence
steps.instruction: The completed program has prepared 11 person clusters, fingerprint-bound audit tables, and a person-record preview. Select Export review artifact if you want portable decision evidence; no export happened automatically.

steps.title: Export durable audit tables
steps.instruction: Inspect the opaque person and accepted-link previews prepared by the AUDIT program stage, then select Export audit tables if desired. Membership uses source record ordinals but excludes patient identifiers and values.

steps.title: Acknowledge the person-level output
steps.instruction: The OUTPUT program stage prepared the seven declared field mappings and 11 records. Review them, then select the acknowledgement. CSV, provenance JSON, and the declared patientlinks.duckdb download become available only now.

steps.title: Inspect the audit history
steps.instruction: Open History to confirm the source, plan version, status, and aggregate result summary.
